source.stem:
The graph represents the motion of a train travelling between two stations.
0 100 200 300 400 500 600 700 800 900 Which statement about the train is correct?

options.text: Its acceleration takes a longer time than its deceleration.
It travels at constant speed for less than half of its journey time.
It travels 2000 m in the first 100 s.
It travels 10⁰⁰0 m at constant speed.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: The SI unit of length is centimetre (cm).

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Handspan is a standard length unit.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Centimetre is not a standard length unit.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Metre written in words without m is not a standard unit.

intelligence.enrichment: A standard length unit is needed so measurements of the same length made by different people are the same. The International System of Units is adopted as standard units, and the SI unit of length is metre with symbol m. shared standard unit -> comparable measurements across people and places The learner correctly applies this rule: A standard length unit is needed so measurements of the same length made by different people are the same. The International System of Units is adopted as standard units, and the SI unit of length is metre with symbol m. Any familiar unit that people use for length is a standard unit.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Measurement of length and motion. The student must decide: Decide whether a length unit is suitable as a standard unit for shared measurements. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
